title: Бытие 13 — Genesis 13
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: Авраам с женой и всем имуществом отправился из ___ в Нигев.
cases.translation: Abram set out from Egypt to the Negev with his wife and all his possessions.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of / from) always takes the genitive → Египта.

cases.sentence: Хананеи и Ферезеи жили тогда в той ___.
cases.translation: The Canaanites and Perizzites were living in the land at that time.
cases.explain: В marking a location (жили в… — no motion) takes the prepositional → земле.

cases.sentence: Между ___ Авраама и пастухами Лота случился раздор.
cases.translation: Strife arose between the herdsmen of Abram and the herdsmen of Lot.
cases.explain: The preposition между (between) takes the instrumental → пастухами (instrumental plural).

cases.translation: Lot chose the whole plain of the Jordan for himself.
cases.explain: Долина is the direct object of выбрал (chose) → accusative; feminine -а becomes -у.

cases.sentence: Лот жил среди городов долины, поставив шатры невдалеке от ___.
cases.translation: Lot lived among the cities of the plain, pitching his tents near Sodom.
cases.explain: The preposition от (near / from) takes the genitive → Содома.

cases.translation: He built an altar there to the Lord.
cases.explain: The altar was built to (for) the Lord — the recipient goes in the dative → Господу.

cases.sentence: Это было еще до того, как Господь разрушил Содом и ___.
cases.translation: This was before the Lord destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah.
cases.explain: Гоморра is a direct object of разрушил (destroyed) → accusative; feminine -а becomes -у.

cases.sentence: Пусть не будет раздора, потому что мы ___.
cases.translation: Let there be no strife, for we are relatives.
cases.explain: As the predicate of мы (we) with the present-tense “are” omitted, it stays nominative → родственники.

reading.ru: У Авраама теперь было много скота, серебра и золота.
reading.question: What did Abram have a great amount of?
reading.explain: The text says Abram had much livestock, silver, and gold.

reading.ru: Между пастухами Авраама и пастухами Лота случился раздор.
reading.question: What happened between the herdsmen of Abram and of Lot?
reading.explain: The text states that strife arose between the two groups of herdsmen.

reading.ru: Лот выбрал себе всю долину Иордана и отправился на восток.
reading.question: What did Lot choose, and which direction did he travel?
options: The Jordan valley; he went east
The hill country; he went west
The city of Bethel; he went north
reading.correct: The Jordan valley; he went east
reading.explain: Lot chose the whole Jordan valley and set out toward the east.

reading.ru: Жители Содома были нечестивы и тяжко грешили против Господа.
reading.question: What were the people of Sodom like?
options: Wicked and great sinners against the Lord
reading.correct: Wicked and great sinners against the Lord
reading.explain: The text says the men of Sodom were wicked and sinned greatly against the Lord.

reading.ru: Всю землю, которую ты видишь, я дам тебе и твоему потомству навеки.
reading.question: What did the Lord promise to give Abram and his offspring?
options: All the land he could see, forever
reading.correct: All the land he could see, forever
reading.explain: The Lord promised Abram all the land he saw for him and his offspring forever.

reading.ru: Аврам свернул шатры и направился жить невдалеке от великих деревьев Мамры в Хевроне.
reading.question: Where did Abram go to settle at the end of the chapter?
options: By the great trees of Mamre in Hebron
On the plain of the Jordan
reading.correct: By the great trees of Mamre in Hebron
reading.explain: Abram moved his tents and settled near the great trees of Mamre in Hebron.
